svg.title: Measured graphite records and reconstructed model fits
svg.desc: Baseline and hot graphite back-face temperature rises share one scale. Solid curves join every original raw logger record within the fitting window. Dashed curves are conditional constant-property one-dimensional conduction fits, not confidence intervals. Time zero is the detected back-face rise, not measured flame-on. The uniform initial field at that delayed marker is an approximation. Fitted effective graphite-reference fluxes are 0.2592 and 0.5844 megawatts per square metre; numerical agreement and residuals do not establish physical accuracy or instrument uncertainty.
